id: \bI've been scamming a guy for weeks by selling him bad items. Have one, I've got too many to count.
en: \bI've been scamming a guy for weeks by selling him bad items. Have one, I've got too many to count.
it: \bSono settimane che truffo un tizio vendendogli strumenti scadenti. Prendine uno, ne ho troppi per contarli.

id: \bI'm so sick of berries. I want the town to go back to normal.
en: \bI'm so sick of berries. I want the town to go back to normal.
it: \bNe ho abbastanza delle bacche. Voglio che la città torni alla normalità.

id: \bTake this. I don't need it anymore. Don't ask why.
en: \bTake this. I don't need it anymore. Don't ask why.
it: \bPrendi questo. Non mi serve più. Non chiedermi perché.
